verdict.rationale: Rippling's marketing pages say dynamic rules handle everything from provisioning accounts to managing group access. They also say access, permissions and groups update automatically when roles change, driven by role changes and company policy. This covers the core of rule-based dynamic group membership replacing manual grants. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of group-based app assignment (assigning apps to a group rather than to individuals), in-depth admin docs on how rules are built, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing claims.
